# Beginner Agentic Tutorial

> Tutor guides for Claude Code. Student pages with copy-paste prompts: https://jonathanpilnick.github.io/beginner_agentic_tutorial/week10/index.html . A student asks you to be their tutor for a lab; read that lab's guide completely and follow it. The student's requests come first. Lab 1 can start in any folder and downloads the kit; Lab 2 and the project expect Claude Code to run inside the week10_rag folder of this repository, with its .venv active.

## Week 10: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (two days)

- [Day 1 · Lab 1: Search your documents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonathanpilnick/beginner_agentic_tutorial/main/week10_rag/tutor/lab1_search.md): setup, embeddings and similarity, chunking, a ChromaDB index, search
- [Day 2 · Lab 2: Answer with sources](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonathanpilnick/beginner_agentic_tutorial/main/week10_rag/tutor/lab2_answer.md): build the prompt, call Claude via claude -p, grounding rules, citations, "I don't know"
- [Day 2 · Final project: Ask My Docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonathanpilnick/beginner_agentic_tutorial/main/week10_rag/tutor/project_ask_my_docs.md): a Q&A bot over the student's own documents, hit@3 test, PROJECT_README.md, peer review, demo
- [Student start page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonathanpilnick/beginner_agentic_tutorial/main/week10_rag/tutor/README.md): start lines and how tutoring works
